dsh-git.name: @litingyes/dsh-git
dsh-git.description: Git for DeepSeek Harness: a chat-page branch switcher in the status row below the composer, plus a right-sidebar tab with a multi-branch commit graph, right-click commit actions (cherry-pick, revert, drop), working-tree staging and committing, branch merge/rebase, and branch and worktree management for the Session's workspace.

dsh-context7.name: @litingyes/dsh-context7
dsh-context7.description: Context7 documentation for DeepSeek Harness: connects the official Context7 MCP server so agents can resolve libraries and fetch current documentation and code examples.
